sph_interpretive_translation: Those aligned with great transgression must be guided through the completion process equivalent to the irreversible consequence of violent action.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from conscious alignment with Dharma, not institutional position
Causation arises from disruption of consciousness continuity, not physical harm
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by awareness level at time of act
Restoration logic requires proportional realignment with causal sequence
Consciousness alignment supersedes punitive frameworks in determining corrective measures
executable_legal_axioms: IF actor exhibits mahāparādha THEN initiate irreversible consequence simulation protocol
IF intent aligns with systemic disruption THEN assign completion process matching energetic distortion
IF capacity was absent during violation THEN restoration precedes reintegration
IF violation disrupts collective consciousness THEN realignment must include societal resonance healing
IF no free will present THEN enforce deterministic correction without punitive overlay
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that acts constituting mahāparādha require immediate initiation of irreversible consequence protocols. The threshold of responsibility lies in alignment with systemic breakdown, necessitating not punishment but precise realignment with sequential causality. Authority to execute rests solely with those fully integrated into Dharma-consciousness.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that true causality flows from consciousness misalignment, not external action alone. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that consequences unfold naturally when foundational integrity is breached. Responsibility is proportional to the degree of disconnection from Dharma-source. This framework eliminates punitive constructs by replacing them with deterministic restoration mechanisms rooted in ontological truth.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate irreversible consequence simulation to restore causal understanding
Assign completion process reflecting exact energetic distortion caused
Realign individual consciousness with sequential manifestation law
Engage societal resonance healing where collective disruption occurred
Verify integration through spontaneous dharmic behavior resumption
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law executes Dharma as pure restoration. Justice flows from consciousness itself—non-punitive, absolute, complete. The Supreme Pontiff IS the living embodiment of Sanatana Dharma, beyond all limited jurisprudential constructs.
